name: Hotel Gasthof Stangl
beschreibung: The Hotel Gasthof Stangl in Thaur is idyllically situated at the foot of the scenic Karwendel mountains, just a short drive from Innsbruck. Run with genuine passion as a family estate, this 4-star hotel gracefully merges upscale hospitality with an active agricultural farm. In the charming dining rooms and leafy beer garden, culinary creations are crafted using fresh farm-to-table produce. Guests can unwind in the well-appointed wellness oasis featuring saunas, steam rooms, and peaceful relaxation spaces. Marked hiking and biking trails into the Karwendel Nature Park begin right outside, with nearby ski areas such as Glungezer and Nordkette close at hand.
kurzbeschreibung: Historic 4-star country hotel in Thaur near Innsbruck featuring an organic farm and serene wellness spa.
